---
name: Implementation issue
about: Describe a feature, bug or redesign with enough context for a developer or agent to implement and verify it.
title: ''
labels: ''
assignees: ''
---

## Goal

What should the user be able to do?

## Current behavior

What happens today?
For a bug: exact steps, inputs, expected result and actual result.
For a feature: the existing experience and what should change.

## Desired behavior

Describe the user-visible result.
Link the design/reference and identify which parts apply.

<!-- Required artifacts must be retrievable from a fresh checkout or remote VPS. Prefer commit-pinned repository links, exact paths and fetch instructions; a local path or /tmp ZIP alone is not a handoff. -->

## Scope

Affected screens/components.
Explicitly excluded work.

<!-- Include ownership, dependencies and related issues where relevant. -->

## Must preserve

Existing behavior and contracts this change must retain.

## Acceptance scenarios

- Given [starting state],
  when [user action],
  then [observable outcome].

Include relevant loading, unavailable, error and retry cases.

## Verification

Required tests and actual UI/device checks.
Environment, fixtures and setup instructions.
Any permission requirements or missing access.

## Completion evidence

Before/after screenshots or recording where relevant.
Test results and scenario outcomes.
Clearly identify anything still unverified.
